details:
SPACE GUARDIAN – Save Our Astronaut!

SPACE GUARDIAN is an interactive educational software project designed to demonstrate how astronauts' health can be monitored during space missions.

The project includes a simulated health-monitoring dashboard that displays heart rate, body temperature and oxygen saturation. It demonstrates how unusual readings can trigger health alerts, helping users understand the importance of monitoring astronauts' health. It also includes interactive mission scenarios and a five-question quiz to make learning engaging.

The main benefit of the project is that it helps students understand the challenges astronauts may face in space and how technology can support health monitoring and mission safety.

Our intended impact is to create awareness about astronaut health, encourage interest in space science and introduce students to the use of software in solving real-world challenges.

The project was developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. We also used AI assistance during development and Canva to prepare the project presentation.

The creative aspect of SPACE GUARDIAN is its combination of a simulated health dashboard, warning alerts, mission-based activities and a quiz in one interactive learning experience.

Our team considered simplicity, ease of use, educational value, astronaut safety and the importance of clearly distinguishing simulated readings from real medical data.

Note: All health readings are simulated for educational purposes. The project is not connected to real medical sensors or NASA systems and is not intended for medical diagnosis.
